Overview.Name: A. Saisree
Overview.Food_Habit: I lose control if I start eating
Overview.Goal: Looking better (appearance), Feeling energetic & confident, Preventing/reversing health issues, Mental wellbeing & stress reduction
Overview.Preference_Notes: Balanced – include non-veg but not in every meal

Meal_1: Option 1: 3 egg omelette (pan fried in ghee)
Option 3: RICE RAWA upma (small) + 2 boiled eggs
Meal_2: Option 1: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) + chicken curry (small portion) + vegetable curry
Option 2: Cooked rice (3/4 cup cooked ~110 g) + egg curry (2 eggs) + vegetable curry
Option 3: Cooked rice (3/4 cup cooked ~110 g) + paneer curry (80 g) + vegetable curry
Meal_3: Option 1: Cooked rice (1/2 cup cooked ~75 g) + chicken curry (small portion)
Option 2: Egg omelette (2 eggs) + cucumber salad
Option 3: Paneer cubes (60–80 g) + vegetable curry (lightest option)

Notes_and_Tips: With thyroid and fat loss goal, keep protein high and rice controlled.
Start every meal with eggs, chicken or paneer before eating rice.
Avoid fried snacks and sweets, especially during stress or late nights.
Fix dinner before 8:30–9 pm to improve fat loss and thyroid balance.
Maintain consistent meal timings even on irregular work days.
With consistency, expect gradual inch loss around waist and hips in 10–12 weeks.
